title: Annual report.
bodyText: The authority shall submit to the governor and the legislature, at least twenty days prior to the start of any regular session, a complete and detailed report of its activities.
bodyHtml: [§206E-19]  Annual report.  The authority shall submit to the governor and the legislature, at least twenty days prior to the start of any regular session, a complete and detailed report of its activities. [L 1976, c 153, pt of §1]
